title: Activity Diagram — Subscribe to Availability Alert
preconditions: 3. Suitable capacity is currently unavailable or protected by another ACTIVE hold.

nodes.label: Patient chooses Notify Me When Available
Direct Patient to normal booking; create no hidden reservation
Confirm subscription as interest only — no hold / queue / priority
Wait for approved capacity-return event, successful Patient booking, or session end
Expire corresponding subscription after successful Patient booking
Detect zero-to-positive bookable capacity from approved Aafiatak event
Notify eligible subscriptions through Notification Service
Patient competes through normal booking; first valid ReservationHold wins
Keep subscription lifecycle subject to duplicate-notification suppression until booking/session end

edges.meaning: Normal booking opportunity; no alert reservation
Subscription remains governed by lifecycle/duplicate-suppression rules

binding_business_rules: Subscription expires on session end or successful relevant booking.
After an alert, normal ReservationHold competition applies.
General alert notifications use Notification Service/system channel, not WhatsApp.
explicitly_forbidden: Automatic capacity import from internal facility schedule.
qa_gates: 1. Verify the exact Use Case title and scope.
2. Verify the Initial Node exists and has no incoming flow.
3. Verify the Activity Final exists and has no outgoing flow.
4. Verify every Action is source-supported and verb-led.
5. Verify every Decision has meaningful guarded outgoing flows.
6. Verify every Merge is used only to reunite alternatives, not as decoration.
7. Verify Fork/Join is absent unless true parallelism is explicitly required.
8. Verify all arrows are Control Flows unless an Object Flow is explicitly specified.
10. Verify no Sequence lifeline/message notation appears.
11. Verify actor permissions and product boundaries.
12. Verify independent lifecycle states are not collapsed into one generic status.
13. Verify all rendered branch guards are mutually understandable and not contradictory.
14. Render SVG/PNG/PDF; open every actual output and inspect it visually.
15. Compare the render against this MD item-by-item and correct semantic, notation, routing, and readability issues.
